name: Gubbins
description: A local-first, offline-capable PWA for tracking anything you own - with barcode/QR scanning, full-text search, component-supplier datasheet scraping, and more.

paragraphs: Gubbins runs entirely in your browser — no install or local server required.

First load registers a service worker and may refresh once — this is expected (it enables the in-browser database). Your data lives in the browser profile you use, so use the same browser to find it again.

A local-first, offline-capable Progressive Web App for tracking anything — electronics, 3D-printing supplies, tools, collections, household items, and general inventory. All data resides and is processed entirely within the user's browser/device.
features: Start using it. All data is stored locally on your device (in the browser's OPFS); nothing is sent to a server.
(Optional) Click Install in your browser to add Gubbins as a standalone, offline-capable app.
Track anything: items with categories, custom fields (eleven types, including image and file), weighted capabilities, quantities, photos, and attachments (a URL, or a pointer to a local file).

Hierarchical, colour-coded locations with descriptions, per-location item counts, custom fields that nested locations can inherit, photos you can mark regions on, and optional dimensions so you can see how full a space…
Per-location stock ledger — quantities tracked independently at each location, with transfers between them.

whatItDoes.text: Gubbins runs entirely in your browser — no install or local server required.

requirements.text: Multiple password-protected accounts behind a sign-in gate, off by default — switch it on and Gubbins asks who you are before it opens.

Because the push comes from a browser, the bridge only accepts it from an origin on its CORS allow-list — the hosted site and loopback by default, so a self-hosted app needs its own origin added via GUBBINSBRIDGEALLOWEDORIGINS.
